title: 7th Club Meeting - Navratri Night
summary: On 24th October, our Rotary Club of Mumbai Kandivali West celebrated a vibrant and joyful Navratri Night, bringing together 88 Rotarians and their family members for an evening filled with enthusiasm, fellowship, and festive spirit.
description:
On 24th October, our Rotary Club of Mumbai Kandivali West celebrated a vibrant and joyful Navratri Night, bringing together 88 Rotarians and their family members for an evening filled with enthusiasm, fellowship, and festive spirit. Members dressed in colorful traditional attire and participated in energetic Garba, creating a lively and joyous atmosphere. The event provided a wonderful opportunity for members and families to bond, strengthen friendships, and celebrate our rich cultural heritage. Delicious refreshments, music, and laughter added to the charm of the evening, making it a memorable celebration that reflected the true spirit of Rotary fellowship and togetherness.

Prizes were given for following categories :-
1. Best Female Dancer : Manisha Shah, Prithika Samani, Sheetal Gaglani
2. Best Male Dancer : Mitesh Shah, Kamlesh Samani
3. Best Female Costume : Archana Patel, Anjali Upasani
4. Best Male Costume : Uday Shah, Vipul Gaglani
